# nanelo_records (Data Source)

Lists the records in a zone, including the NS and SOA records Nanelo manages itself.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nanelo_records" "mx" {
  name = "example.org"
  type = "MX"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only return records with this fully-qualified name.
- `type` (String) Only return records of this type.
- `zone` (String) Zone to list. Defaults to the provider's `zone`, or to the API key's only zone.

### Read-Only

- `records` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Fully-qualified name.
- `priority` (Number)
- `system_record` (Boolean) Whether Nanelo manages the record itself.
- `ttl` (Number)
- `type` (String)
- `value` (String)
